public_gates: audit M524 natural L3-vs-L0 event rows
report event semantics, source diversity, and duplicate rate
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not hide duplicate or source concentration
do not relabel obstacle-completion drops as collisions or success drops
hypothesis: M524 natural history-value event rows survive source-diversity and duplicate audits and represent real L3-vs-L0 obstacle-completion differences.
success_criteria: source and duplicate summaries are written
failure_criteria: event rows are source-narrow or duplicated
event semantics are inconsistent with M524 summaries
audit mixes projected and natural rows
training or checkpoint promotion is performed

commands.name: history_value_event_audit
commands.command: Implement or run an audit over runs/m524_natural_history_value_ablation/history_value_rows.csv.

decision_rule: M526 is not a promotion gate; it should decide whether M524 event rows support matched-baseline training or require surface repair.
